entities.summary: Jemilah binti Mahmood is a Malaysian physician. She has served as Pro-Chancellor of the Heriot-Watt University Malaysia (HWUM) since September 2021, Professor and Executive Director of Sunway Centre for Planetary Health since August 2021, and Senior Fellow at the Adrienne-Arsht-Rockefeller Foundation Resilience Center. She has been a Board Member of Roche since 2022. She served as Special Advisor to the former Prime Minister of Malaysia Muhyiddin Yassin on Public Health from March 2020 to August 2021 and Under-Secretary General for Partnerships in the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) from January 2016 to 2020.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a leading public health expert and senior fellow at the Adrienne-Arsht-Rockefeller Foundation Resilience Center, Jemilah Mahmood has played a crucial role in shaping Malaysia's response to the COVID-19 pandemic. Her work has contributed significantly to the development of national health policies.
